description: Looks up pharmacy price estimates for a verified NDC and retrieves or issues the session’s free reusable savings card. Returns prices, card codes, and view/print links. This does not purchase medication, select a pharmacy, or send a message.

card_session_id.description: Private UUID for this conversation. Reuse the returned cardSessionId or the UUID already used. For a new conversation with no prior issuance attempt, generate one UUID internally before the first price or card call. Never ask the customer for it or replace it after uncertain issuance.

existing_card_reference.description: Existing ClixRx card or coupon share reference, when available. Reuse the existing card instead of issuing another; never invent a reference.

ndc.description: National Drug Code (NDC) from a prior search_drug call

quantity.description: Exact dispensed quantity explicitly supplied by the user, positive and at most 360 (fractions allowed); ask when absent and never assume 30

zip_code.description: Five-digit US ZIP explicitly supplied by the user in this conversation; ask when absent

name: get_prices
